fields.stage: Phase 3 ZUPREME recruiting; Phase 2 diabetes topline reported
fields.summary: Zealand announced ZUPREME-2 diabetes Phase 2 topline results on 7 October 2026, reporting 7.4–9.2% mean weight reduction at week 28 using the efficacy estimand versus 2.0% with placebo. These are sponsor-reported findings pending full results. The completed NCT06926842 registry has no posted results and records 221 actual participants, whereas the sponsor reports 220. ZUPREME-3, ZUPREME-4 and ZUPREME-5 are now recruiting. ZUPREME-3 and -5 record actual 30 September starts; ZUPREME-4 retains an estimated 30 September start. The populations are respectively without type 2 diabetes, with type 2 diabetes, and with established cardiovascular disease.
fields.limitations: The Phase 2 announcement is topline sponsor evidence, not a full independent outcome review, comparative ranking or prescribing guide. The 221/220 enrolment discrepancy remains unresolved. Phase 3 enrolment and completion remain estimated and none of the three records has posted results. ZUPREME-5 studies weight management in people with cardiovascular disease; that population does not demonstrate cardiovascular-event prevention. The sponsor says the first Phase 3 participants have begun treatment, but this is not assigned as an actual start to ZUPREME-4 while its record retains an estimate. The petrelintide–enicepatide combination remains separate research; planned initiation is not completed dosing evidence. Specialist-indication research does not establish UK authorisation, NICE/NHS access or actual supply.

fields.summary: NIDDK's NCT05713799 record describes an oral mirabegron and alpha-lipoic acid crossover pilot in adults with obesity. The 8 October 2026 update remains not yet recruiting, with its estimated start moved again to 13 October 2026, 60 estimated participants and estimated March 2030 completion. Its primary endpoint is insulin sensitivity, with metabolic and exploratory body-composition outcomes.
fields.limitations: First posted in February 2023: an older study, not an October medicine launch. The 13 October start remains estimated, not actual dosing, and no results are posted. The detailed protocol retains a 48-person target while the enrolment field estimates 60; this discrepancy is preserved. Metabolic study aims are not demonstrated weight-loss benefit, a prescribing recommendation or approval of this combination.

discoveryPass.method: Separate dated and broader undated searches for obesity, peptide/oral combinations, muscle preservation, specialist indications and paused/discontinued programmes across the requested developers and smaller/international developers; reconciled main, PR851 and open Watch reviews.
discoveryPass.included: ZUPREME-2 was an older exact-record omission in the existing petrelintide programme; added without duplicating the programme or the separate ZYNERGY combination.
incompleteChecks: Combined developer-domain searches yielded uneven or irrelevant coverage, especially AstraZeneca, Hansoh/Merck and Kailera; none is represented as a complete survey.
Novo, Lilly, Amgen, Pfizer, Viking, Structure and Boehringer searches produced primary leads, several already tracked; unmatched leads remain pending full source review.
No new MHRA authorisation, NICE/NHS access or verified supply change established.
Search indexing delays and older, unannounced or additional international programmes remain possible.
